$comment: Every project checked. A project is benchmarked only if the reference checker reports 0 errors on it (the gate); otherwise the run records why it was rejected. Fields: title: the display name in charts; repo/sha: what `node bench setup` clones into projects/<name>/; install: steps run in the checkout, in order: {run: [program, ...args], env?}, {copy: [from, to]} or {remove: path}, where {fixtures} is the fixtures/ directory; no shell is used, so the steps work on every OS; node: minimum Node version the install needs (fnm is used to get it when the current node is older); args: the project's own typecheck arguments, with where they come from; patch: deliberate type errors for the parity check, in fixtures/patches/.

projects.description: A type-level library; its check cost is almost all its own test-d suite
projects.installNote: type-fest commits no lockfile and sets package-lock=false; the fixture pins the dependency tree.
